text:
rachel: Quick recap from today's review  main bits: p95 visibility, sampler language confusion, and tiny keyboard/a11y gaps.

diego: on p95 visibility  i tried overlay + glow + dashed combos. the glow looks nice but can smear on mobile screenshots. dashed white 2px with a 1px inner shadow seems the most legible across palettes.

yasmin: sampler copy confusion: people read `0.1` and think fraction or percent. Make it explicit: `Sampling: 0.1% (approx 1 in 1000)`. Also show a compact explainer on hover: "Lower sampling reduces load on live dashboards; increases noise."

rachel: could we show effective sample count in the tooltip? like `sampled: ~820 calls` so folks understand confidence.

diego: yes, we can surface `sample_count` from the backend in the hover. engineering ok with adding that field?

ux-helper: @dieg o proto link: https://staging.redwood.dev/ux/1995003210/preview  includes dashed overlay + sample count in tooltip.

yasmin: scrubber hit target: QA reported misses on Mac trackpads. proposal: keep visible thumb small but increase pointer area to 28px via ::before invisible element. CSS only.

rachel: keyboard accessibility: let's standardize on arrow=1s, shift+arrow=10s, ctrl+arrow=1m. please include a11y tooltip when focused listing those shortcuts.

diego: overlay toggle: modes = Auto / On / Off. Auto = overlay on desktop, off on mobile (<720px). Show current mode in the heatmap menu as a compact state chip.

yasmin: presets naming: trials with Economy / Balanced / Fidelity landed well in testing. suggested microcopy for Balanced: "balanced tail visibility and throughput". Also add a small info icon linking to docs: `/docs/observability/sampling`.

rachel: visual tokens: avoid pure red/green extremes. new token ramp suggestion: `#f8fbff -> #fff8ea -> #ffe7cf -> #e06a44` (will test contrast). If the extreme bucket fails contrast we add a 1px inner stroke.

diego: small engineering constraint: computing bucket luminance per render is expensive. We'll compute once on ingestion and attach `bucket_lightness` flags so CSS can pick stroke color. Backend owner ok with adding flag.

yasmin: screenreader notes: p50/p95 should be exposed as a single aria-live region when the time range changes: `Median 32 ms; 95th percentile 128 ms; sample size 7,482`. That prevents extra noise.

rachel: research ask: can designQA run 6 quick tasks with engineers (5m each) to validate tap targets and tooltip clarity? ux-helper says there's a slot Wed 2pm.

ux-helper: user-testing slot confirmed Wed 14:00 (6 participants)  recording enabled. Prototype: https://staging.redwood.dev/ux/1995003210/preview

diego: owners: diego = overlay visuals + adaptive stroke impl, yasmin = copy + a11y strings + aria-live, rachel = research coordination + presets microcopy. Sync Thu 9:00 for review (10m).

yasmin: I'll add the hover strings and update Figma by EOD.

diego: i'll push a small token PR and the backend flag change for bucket lightness tomorrow.

rachel: perfect. thanks team :clap:
